property.name: checklistIds
property.label: Document Checklist Ids (comma-separated)
property.description: ITER 3 TEST DESIGN ATTRIBUTE — paste a comma-separated list of Document_CheckList__c record Ids (e.g. a0XIn00000ABCDE,a0XIn00000FGHIJ). Removed in Iter 6 when Dock Panel host wires IDs at runtime.

property.name: headerTitle
property.label: Header Title
property.description: Title shown in the top bar.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Checklists per page
property.description: How many checklists are shown per page in the pagination footer.

property.name: preventDownload
property.label: Hide download button
property.description: Hide the Download button in the preview modal.

property.name: fileValidatorClassName
property.label: File validator Apex class
property.description: Optional. An Apex class implementing FileValidator to gate Delete/Download per file.

property.name: enableAdhocAdd
property.label: Enable ad-hoc add (+)
property.description: ITER 4 — shows the '+' control to add an ad-hoc document (Document Type fixed to OTHER + Applicant Type). Used by Dock Panel (B) and Non-Individual (C) flows.

property.name: mode
property.label: Mode (upload | preview)
property.description: 'upload' shows the '+ New Ad-Hoc File' flow and write actions; 'preview' shows the Applicant/Document Type filters and is preview-only.
